title: Add Calibrated Decisions to build
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Calibrated Decisions](https://jonakss--calibrated-decisions-app-page.modal.run) to build
- A visual playground for the Pollinations Jev typed-decisions API (POST /alpha/decisions). Write a decision state, build typed questions (choice with record options, score with ordered rungs, noul yes/

Fixes #15323

gist.headline: Decisions get a playground
gist.blurb: Calibrated Decisions joins the app collection. Write a decision state, arrange some typed questions, and see where the branches lead.
gist.summary: Added Calibrated Decisions to the app collection, a visual playground for the Pollinations Jev typed-decisions API at POST /alpha/decisions with choice and score questions.
gist.impact: People exploring POST /alpha/decisions can now use a visual app to build decision states, including choices with record options and scores with ordered rungs.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Calibrated Decisions as a friendly tabletop of branching decision cards: record-option cards on one path and ordered score rungs on another. Polli helps arrange the cards; no app-specific mascot or logo is identified in the PR.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli wears tiny reading glasses and gently arranges branching decision cards beside a retro screen labeled 'DECISIONS'; one branch holds choice cards and another climbs ordered score rungs, with flowers growing around the table. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium within the scene, never oversized, in strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream and lavender, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
